On an automotive assembly line, speed and accuracy are critical to ensure maximum line uptime, and tool mix-ups mean rework and downtime. At Subaru of Indiana Automotive, associates run multiple vehicle models simultaneously, working with tooling that can differ by just a few millimeters between variants. The right tool has to be obvious. SIA turned to color coding to simplify tool selection for its operators.

3D printed ABS provided color for low volume custom parts, but did not meet the durability that automotive manufacturing requires. On a factory floor where tools are picked up, set down, and reused hundreds of times a shift, Subaru of Indiana Automotive needed a stronger solution. 

Onyx GF provided the necessary strength and color coding ability, running within SIA's existing Markforged ecosystem for seamless integration. 

Learn more about SIA's use of Onyx GF in our latest blog post here: https://lnkd.in/gN6WJJVh

Western Australian company Hydratune has developed a digital platform for the safe and accurate maintenance of hydraulic equipment that substantially reduces losses caused by hydraulic inefficiency on mine sites worldwide.

“The flexibility of AM makes it easy and inexpensive to customize the product to meet unusual equipment configurations. Unit cost of the bracket has been slashed from $300 to $90, weight has been reduced and the brackets can be printed overnight.” — Shane Lewis, Managing Director, HydraTune

“We simply visit the site with 3D scanner to analyse the requirement. We can then design an adaptor specifically for that piece of equipment and print it in stainless steel overnight on the FX10. It’s such a cool thing to be able to do,” said Shane.

La 3D au service du MCO

📍 Sur la Base aérienne 204 Mérignac-Beauséjour, le maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) franchit un nouveau cap grâce à la fabrication additive.

Le Pôle national d’impression 3D (PN-I3D) pilote un dispositif inédit reposant sur :
👉 23 micro-usines SmartFarm V4 modulaires et évolutives
👉 34 imprimantes 3D professionnelles dédiées au MCO et à l’innovation
👉 un réseau déployé sur 25 bases aériennes, en métropole et en outre-mer

Ce maillage interconnecté permet de produire des pièces localement, au plus près du besoin, à tout moment.

📈 Les bénéfices : prévention des casses, meilleure disponibilité des aéronefs et près de 33 000 € d’économies par équipement.

Et un impact concret et positif sur les opérations !
